---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability or enhancement
title: "[feat] "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
---

## Problem

What problem does this solve? Concrete user scenario, not a generic wish.

## Proposed solution

High-level sketch of the API / command / flag you have in mind. Name it
if you have a name.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways you thought about solving this, and why you prefer the proposal.

## Compatibility

- Does this require a breaking change? (see `COMPATIBILITY.md`)
- Can it be delivered additively in a minor release?

## Additional context

Links to prior art in similar tools, relevant specs, or downstream consumers
that would benefit.
